qa_pair.question: Cross-check the latest revision note with the part-rating table. Which exact module identifier is installed at U1? Reply with the identifier only.
Compare the required lower supply boundary with the selected module's own lower boundary. How much positive input-voltage margin is available? Reply with a number and V.
Use the module rating and the thermal qualification rule to calculate the maximum allowed case temperature at the stated operating ambient. Reply with the value and C.
After locating the acceptance criterion, what peak-to-peak ripple ceiling is required? Reply with the value and mV.
Compare all repeat-run ripple readings with the acceptance ceiling. What is the largest reading, and does it pass? Reply as “value mV, PASS” or “value mV, FAIL”.
Subtract the continuous load requirement from the selected module's continuous rating. What current reserve remains? Reply with a value and A.
What is the nominal isolated output rail described in both the assembly overview and the electrical limits? Reply with the voltage and “DC”.
Find the external enable signal's connector assignment. Reply as connector-pin, for example J2-1.
How many distinct references appear in the assembly bill of materials? Reply with the integer only.
What is the minimum acceptable efficiency stated in the verification matrix? Reply as a percentage.
